summary: Evaluates the four cubic Hermite basis functions at parameter t=a8 using SSE intrinsics and blends four input vectors (a4-a7) with the resulting basis weights. Computes t^2 and t^3, evaluates the basis polynomial with coefficient constants xmmword_5D8A50/60/70/80, broadcasts each of the four resulting basis values via shuffles, and writes the weighted sum to the output pointer a3. Straight-line, unconditional, no callees.

local_names.a1: register vector holding t^2 in lane 0
local_names.a2: register vector holding t^3 in lane 0
local_names.a3: output pointer for the blended result vector
local_names.a4: first input vector (weighted by basis value 0)
local_names.a5: second input vector (weighted by basis value 1)
local_names.a6: third input vector (weighted by basis value 2)
local_names.a7: fourth input vector (weighted by basis value 3)
local_names.v9: vector holding the four cubic Hermite basis values evaluated at t

operations.description: Broadcast the scalar parameter t=a8 into vector v8 and square it into lane 0 of a1, yielding t^2.
Compute t^3 = a8 * t^2 into lane 0 of a2.

Evaluate the cubic Hermite basis polynomial at t via SSE multiply-accumulate: constant term xmmword_5D8A60, t term xmmword_5D8A80, t^2 term xmmword_5D8A70, t^3 term xmmword_5D8A50; each of the four lanes of v9 holds one basis function value.
Blend the four input vectors a4, a5, a6, a7 using the four basis values broadcast from v9 via shuffle masks 0, 85, 170, 255 (broadcasting lanes 0-3).
Store the blended result vector to the output pointer a3.
